reviews.author: Cesar

reviews.title: Nicer than most for the money
reviews.comment: Seen a lot of different reviews and Im assuming the company has listened. My box said V3 of the product and I had no issues. The RBG plug is not the same as standard its 4 pin spacing with a gap and 3 leads. If you have an older board this wont have rgb for you without a break out cable. That said. It looks fantastic. I7-8700k idling at 33C wich isnt the best but my high performance setup was only 31 C. Bought this while I rebuild as a temp cooler and it works to that purpose. The heat block is NOT flat. So be generouse with the 1.5 grams of thermal compound you get. Bigger CPU dies not recommended. The radiator is exactly the same as what cooler master uses, has the same stamping and all. However these guys crimp and sleeve the lines, which is a very nice upgrade. The hoses are plenty long as you can see in my pictures. I have a full ATX case. Fans move plenty of air and are fairly quiet. For under 50$ Id be hard pressed to buy anything else.

reviews.title: Nice bang for your buck
reviews.comment: I wasn't too sure on this brand seeing as it's a kind of budget brand but I'm pretty surprised how nice this cooler is. Temps are pretty great and build quality feels nice. Hopefully the pump holds up!
reviews.author: Justin

reviews.title: Looks good. Easy to assemble.
reviews.comment: I put this on my son's gaming pc that is running a Ryzen 7 7700x. These run very hot on stock settings and I was hoping for a dramatic change over the large air cooler that was in the pc. I did not notice a change if cpu temps on high load but this cooler appears to be of good quality and it looks great in the case so I decided to keep it.
reviews.author: Tim Kraushaar

reviews.title: Awesome cooler for small form factor builds!
reviews.comment: Great little cooler. Was having trouble cooling an 11th gen Intel with limited space in a smaller case. Used a Thermalright low profile air cooler and was able to get temps down in the low 80’s but still wasn’t satisfied as this was with a minor overlock and undervolt. Decided to give this a try and dropped temps to low 50’s. Was able to overlock another 200 mhz and still temps are low 60’s. More room to go if I choose. The PC is so much quieter now than with the air cooler. Would definitely buy again for a small form factor build. Great price and great performance!
